name: Durvadi Thailam

sections.introduction: Durvadi Thailam is an Ayurvedic skincare oil to get rid of itching and promotes faster healing of non-healing wounds. It is usually prepared in coconut or sesame oil base.
sections.ingredients:
Sesamum indicum oil / Coconut oil 
 Juice extract of Durva (Cynodon dactylon) 
 Durva leaves paste 

 Method of Preparation 
 All the ingredients are processed to form the oil and it is made with Taila paka vidhi. 
 Method of Usage 

 It is only used for external application only and not for internal administration. 
 It is applied to scalp followed by a massage. It is applied at night and washed off the next morning. 
 It can be applied on the affected areas for half an hour and then rinsed off.
sections.indications:
Relieves itching 
 Dandruff 
 Scabies 
 Faster wound healing
sections.contraindications:
There are no reported side effects. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Durvadi Thailam 
 Reference: Sahasrayogam 
 Introduction 
 Durvadi Thailam is an Ayurvedic skincare oil to get rid of itching and promotes faster healing of non-healing wounds. It is usually prepared in coconut or sesame oil base. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Sesamum indicum oil / Coconut oil 
 Juice extract of Durva (Cynodon dactylon) 
 Durva leaves paste 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 All the ingredients are processed to form the oil and it is made with Taila paka vidhi. 
 Method of Usage 
 
 It is only used for external application only and not for internal administration. 
 It is applied to scalp followed by a massage. It is applied at night and washed off the next morning. 
 It can be applied on the affected areas for half an hour and then rinsed off. 
 
 Indications 
 
 Relieves itching 
 Dandruff 
 Scabies 
 Faster wound healing 
 
 Contraindications 
 There are no reported side effects. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
